title: An update on RPG Studio’s AI map generation
author: Samariuml
selftext:
I’ve talked about RPGJS Studio here before, so I wanted to share an update on its third generation of AI map creation.

The goal is to go beyond generating a pretty image. Describe a place and its visual style, and the workflow builds a map from separate layers - terrain, paths, water, walls and scenery - that you can keep editing in the map editor.

RPGJS Engine itself remains open source. Studio is designed to help you create a complete game, from the map and its assets to the gameplay, and I plan to keep expanding it with future updates.

I’m still improving the map-generation workflow, so I’d love to hear from other RPG makers: what matters most after a map is generated, The visual result, the layout, or how easy it is to edit?

I’m the developer of RPGJS Studio, and I’m sharing this update to discuss the workflow and hear your feedback.

Website: [rpgjs.dev](http://rpgjs.dev)  
My X account: [https://x.com/rpgjs\_dev](https://x.com/rpgjs_dev)
